buildCommand: export PATH=$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release
installCommand: V=3.24.0 && S=$HOME/flutter && mkdir -p $S && cd /tmp && curl -L https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_${V}-stable.tar.xz | tar xJ && mv flutter/* $S/ && rm -rf flutter && export PATH=$S/bin:$PATH
